scenario: [LCRS.6.3.3] (LCRS.14.5, the id, is a tombstone): per-call `retain:` on a general (non-hydration) call/response service is reject-until-wired: honoring it requires runtime threading onto the response fact's TTL that v1 does not have, so silent acceptance would retain nothing. `retain` is a reserved modifier name (never a bindable service kwarg) but not an honored general-call modifier. Pin: `call svc.method retain: 30_s` fails loud with DS_VALIDATE_RETAIN_UNWIRED. (The three-layer retraction contract — superseding correlation / per-call retain / safety-net — is honored at the hydration endpoints, where retain: is wired.)
rules_ds:
service svc.method:
    kwarg tag: String
    no response

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig
->
    call svc.method retain: 30_s nocooldown as "x"
